shared_elements: upright carved slab/monument with figural relief
frontal composition on a vertical field
elaborate ornamental border framing a central figural panel
animal forms integrated into the design
figures shown in a stacked, register-like vertical sequence
justification: Both are upright stone monuments whose vertical field carries a dense figural design set within/against elaborate ornament, with content stacked into an upper zone above a lower zone, and both include humans and animal forms; that much is generic to monument carving. The specifics diverge completely: A shows a single large frontal standing personage with an ornate headdress, mask-like face and elaborate costume, its ornament composed of curvilinear glyph-like and mask motifs, whereas B shows a mounted rider on a horse above a ship with a sail/crew, enclosed by a continuous ribbon-interlace border, an entirely different repertoire and set of relationships.
